capabilities: Show a dashboard of a day's checklist with neighbouring days and a cross-project priority queue
Capture unplanned tasks in an inbox with age tracking and staleness warnings
Summarize a week of daily notes, including recurring habit completion
Render an interactive dependency graph of obsidian-pm tasks with inline editing
Promote checklist items into obsidian-pm project tasks with dates, tags, and priority
extras: The manifest states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README links to separate user, technical, and settings guides rather than including usage examples.
intentEvidence: get a few things obsidian-pm alone doesn't provide
problem: Tasks scattered across daily-note checklists and project notes have no unified dashboard, and obsidian-pm shows tasks only as flat notes.

relations.evidence: built on two things your vault already has — project/task notes from obsidian-pm
compatible with the emoji-date format used by the community Tasks plugin

summary: Task dashboard, inbox, weekly review, and dependency graph built on obsidian-pm project notes and Daily Notes checklists.
